stem.text: The compound rotundone is responsible for the peppery smell of pepper and is also found in some red wines.

stem.alt: Skeletal formula of rotundone: a fused five- and seven-membered ring system with a C=O ketone, two methyl groups and a prop-1-en-2-yl group; labelled rotundone.
stem.label: rotundone
